name: Irvine Crossroads
description: Irvine Crossroads is a convenient neighborhood shopping center located on Culver Drive in the heart of Irvine, California. This well-maintained strip center serves the local community with a practical mix of retail stores, services, and dining options that cater to everyday needs.
summary: A neighborhood strip center on Culver Drive offering convenient retail, dining, and services for Irvine residents.
